title: SonicJobs trial cannot supply source links: approve recovery plan or retire it?
detail: For two weekly runs SonicJobs returned job summaries without exact listing links or posting dates. This run preserves 30 source-only leads; none submitted with guessed links. Weekly ZipRecruiter intake continues independently. Proposed change is recorded as a suggestion; no implementation authorized.
blocks: Safe SonicJobs intake and a meaningful assessment of its four-week trial.
options: Approve a scoped investigation and recovery proposal
Retire the SonicJobs trial; retain ZipRecruiter Weekly
recommended: Approve a scoped investigation and recovery proposal; preserve captured leads.
action: Answer in chat; record ruling in asks/resolved/ before any instruction or schedule change.
